_comment: Struct layouts for the record arrays the game indexes by a fixed stride.
Why this file exists. The decompiler cannot see that DAT_0053f9bc is
county[i] + 0x0C, so it invents a separate global for every field of every
record array - 334 of them, a tenth of the binary's globals. Giving the
five arrays a struct type collapses all of those into named fields at once.
What may go in here. Only fields whose NAME comes from docs/ or the Rust
structs in crates/l2-kingdom, and whose WIDTH the binary agrees with.
ghidra_scripts/RecordProbe.java reports the width of every access into each
array; a field whose documented meaning and observed width disagree is left
out and written up, because a wrong field name propagates into every
function that touches it (docs/decisions.md, correction C3).
Offsets not listed stay undefined padding. That is deliberate: a gap you
can see is worth more than a guess you cannot.
Applied by ghidra_scripts/ApplyRecords.java, which runs from
tools/oracle/decompile-all.ps1 after ApplySymbols and before DecompileAll.

structs.name: AiPersonality
structs.comment: One AI lord's personality, 4 records at g_aiPersonality, 0x004D8A58, indexed by realm.lord - 1. l2_kingdom::tables.

fields.name: farmStyle
fields.comment: Copied into the county by AI_ManageFields. Values 1, 1, 0, 9; only a byte-wide access was observed.

fields.name: taxLadder
fields.comment: Selects one of AI_TAX_LADDERS. Values 2, 2, 2, 1.

fields.name: helpPopulationFloor
fields.comment: 750, 800, 900, 1000. A population floor, not a treasury one.

fields.name: musterPct
fields.comment: Percentage of a county's population one AI muster conscripts. 30, 30, 40, 50.

fields.name: castleGold
fields.comment: By castle type 1..5; zero means the type is not offered to this lord.

structs.name: BattleCell
structs.comment: One battlefield cell. 6400 records at g_battlefield, 0x005440E0, in an 80 x 80 grid. INDEXED BY BYTE OFFSET like Tile: cellOffset = (y * 80 + x) * 8, a step east is +8 and a step south is +0x280. docs/battle.md 3.

fields.name: terrain
fields.comment: Terrain id: 1 open, 3 rocks, 4 hills, 7/8/9 bridge parts, 11 water, 12 woodland, 13 the 0x15 lines. docs/formats/skr.md's Lords2 id column.

fields.name: flags
fields.comment: 0x10 and 0x80 impassable - Cell_TryEnter rejects flags & 0x90; 0x40 blocks everyone; 0x20 blocks side != 0 and makes the figure wait rather than reroute.

fields.name: flags2
fields.comment: Further flags; bits 0x1C are cleared and rewritten per cell during the build. [D] - what they select is not established.

fields.name: frame
fields.comment: Graphic index. [D]

fields.name: elevation
fields.comment: Governs missile damage and blocks movement between cells more than 1 apart. Never written by Battlefield_BuildFromSkr, so a .skr battlefield is flat.

fields.name: figure
fields.comment: Slot in g_battleMen of the figure standing here, 0 for none.

fields.name: missileHead
fields.comment: Head of the linked list of missiles in this cell.

fields.name: surface
fields.comment: Surface type: 7 bridge, 10 and 17 burning, 15 woodland, 4/5/6 read by BattleUnit_Order for siege structures. Cell_NeighbourHasSurface tests the four orthogonal neighbours of this byte.

structs.name: BattleMan
structs.comment: One drawn figure, standing for g_menPerFigure real soldiers. 81 records at g_battleMen, 0x00554480; slot 0 unused. Many of these names are the game's own - its debug panel prints them. docs/battle.md 2.1, docs/battle-ai.md.

fields.name: spriteSheet
fields.comment: This figure's sprite sheet, chosen by troop type and by side (+0x2E).

fields.name: horseSheet
fields.comment: Knights only.

fields.name: selectedSeen
fields.comment: Debug-panel label 'selctd seen'.

fields.name: facingDrawn
fields.comment: A copy of dirc2 (+0x19), written at the end of every animation handler.

fields.name: animPhase
fields.comment: The counter the animation handlers actually step: wraps at 0x27 walking, 0x17 attacking, 0x5F dying, and is seeded per figure so identical men do not march in lockstep. docs/battle.md 13.8 corrects 2.1, which attributed both to +0x0C; +0x0C is left unnamed because what it is for was not established.

fields.name: frame
fields.comment: Sprite frame index the renderer draws.

fields.name: horseFrame
fields.comment: Knights only; indexes the 48-frame A2_horse.pl8.

fields.name: troopType
fields.comment: 0..10 in TROOPS*.ENG column order: peasant, crossbowman, maceman, swordsman, pikeman, archer, knight, catapult, siege tower, ram, oil.

fields.name: ownerIsHuman
fields.comment: 1 when the owning realm's +0x05 is set. Changes the damage this figure takes; the design intent of that asymmetry is not established.

fields.name: mercenary
fields.comment: Set for the mercenary contingent of an army.

fields.name: wasHit
fields.comment: Hit since the last unit rebuild; consumed by the rebuild pass.

fields.name: hitBy
fields.comment: Which figure hit this one. The rebuild looks up that figure's unit and stores it as the victim unit's lastAttacker. Two bytes: both observed accesses are 16-bit, and +0x17 is referenced nowhere - l2-sim models it as a u8.

fields.name: dirc
fields.comment: Facing 0..7 clockwise from north; 8 means same cell. Drives the sub-cell offset and the attack animation.

fields.name: dirc2
fields.comment: A second facing byte: drives the idle/walking frame and is the column of the knight table.

fields.name: cellOffset
fields.comment: (y * 80 + x) * 8, kept in step with mapX and mapY.

fields.name: tgX
fields.comment: Where this figure is walking to; written by Formation_SendFigure.

fields.name: tg2X
fields.comment: The figure's own aim point. docs/battle.md 2.1 says this pair is filled from unit +0x26/+0x28 (dest2X/dest2Y); it is not. The only non-zero write in the binary is FUN_004843bc taking the unit's aimX/aimY at +0x16/+0x18, which is the pair docs/battle-ai.md 497 calls the aim point. Three other sites only zero it.

fields.name: owner
fields.comment: Player index; 0 means the slot is free.

fields.name: sheetBank
fields.comment: 0 for side 4, 1 for side 0 - what selects army A's sprite bank from army B's.

fields.name: delayState
fields.comment: The state to return to after a delay.

fields.name: state
fields.comment: 0..17, index into g_manStateTable. Known: 2 dead, 4 melee, 5 idle/firing, 6 blocked, 7 look-for-melee, 9 siege-wall movement, 12 siege-engine attacking, 17 closing to attack.

fields.name: walking
fields.comment: Sub-cell progress; +2 per step, cell crossed at 17.

fields.name: moveTick
fields.comment: Tick counter against moveDelay.

fields.name: stepFlags
fields.comment: Bit 0 ready to leave this cell, bit 1 was interrupted.

fields.name: frameScratch
fields.comment: Per-frame scratch, cleared at the top of every sweep.

fields.name: pathLength
fields.comment: Waypoints left.

fields.name: path
fields.comment: Up to 150 (x, y) waypoint pairs, consumed from the end. 0x38 + 150 * 2 = 0x164, which is where onRoute begins. l2-sim's runner.rs calls +0x144/+0x146 the walk target written by Formation_SendFigure; those offsets are inside this array and no instruction in the binary references either of them.

fields.name: onRoute
fields.comment: 1 while following a stored path rather than walking straight at the target.

fields.name: holdIt
fields.comment: Ticks to wait before asking the pathfinder again; set to 64 after each attempt.

fields.name: routed
fields.comment: How many times this figure has been re-routed. NOT morale.

fields.name: polarDirc
fields.comment: Facing chosen when knocked back or thrown.

fields.name: weaponClass
fields.comment: 0 melee, 1 bow, 2 crossbow, 3 catapult.

fields.name: reloadTicks
fields.comment: g_missileStats[class][1].

fields.name: missileSubSteps
fields.comment: g_missileStats[class][2], always 4.

fields.name: missileSprite
fields.comment: g_missileStats[class][4]; added to the flight direction for the missile frame.

fields.name: range
fields.comment: g_missileStats[class][0], in eighths of a cell.

fields.name: armour
fields.comment: Subtracted from missile damage only. Rewritten every tick from the troop type, so constant per type.

fields.name: target
fields.comment: Figure index this one is shooting at.

fields.name: targeted
fields.comment: Counts down while somebody is shooting at this figure.

fields.name: barred
fields.comment: Consecutive pathfinding failures; at 4 the figure stops trying.

fields.name: unit
fields.comment: Owning unit index.

fields.name: side
fields.comment: 0 or 4, copied from the unit.

fields.name: meleeRecovery
fields.comment: The attacker decrements it; the blow lands at 0.

fields.name: opponent
fields.comment: The other figure in a melee duel.

fields.name: swingTimer
fields.comment: Reload / swing timer.

fields.name: firing
fields.comment: Set to 120 on firing, counts down. The figure-level twin of the unit's firing byte.

fields.name: engaged
fields.comment: In contact - stop walking.

fields.name: exchange
fields.comment: Ticks left holding the attacker role in a duel.

fields.name: role
fields.comment: 1 attacker this exchange, 2 defender.

fields.name: moveDelay
fields.comment: Ticks per movement sub-step.

fields.name: animSet
fields.comment: 0..4 by troop type; also picks the melee exchange length.

fields.name: recovery
fields.comment: Ticks between blows this figure can absorb - the real melee defence.

fields.name: blowUsed
fields.comment: Set once the heavy-blow bonus has been spent. Whether that is once per battle or once per exchange is not established.

fields.name: isSiegeEngine
fields.comment: 1 for troop types 7, 8, 9.

fields.name: band
fields.comment: Strength band 0..3 from men left; scales melee attack and missile damage.

fields.name: heavyBlow
fields.comment: Extra hits landed once per melee exchange: maceman 300, knight 200, swordsman 100, else 0.

fields.name: hits
fields.comment: Accumulated damage. 100 hits kills one man, 160 for a siege engine.

fields.name: meleeAttack
fields.comment: Hits per blow, from g_meleeAttackTable[type][band].

fields.name: missileDamage
fields.comment: Hits per hit, from g_missileStats[class][3].

fields.name: men
fields.comment: Real soldiers still alive in this figure.

fields.name: menLastFrame
fields.comment: Previous value of men, for the UI.

fields.name: movStraff
fields.comment: Set when the figure attacks without closing.

fields.name: age
fields.comment: Age in frames.

structs.name: BattleUnit
structs.comment: What the player selects and orders in a battle. 81 records at g_battleUnits, 0x00566520; every sweep is for (i = 1; i < 0x51; i++), so slot 0 is unused and slot 80 is real. docs/battle.md 2, docs/battle-ai.md.

fields.name: owner
fields.comment: Player index; 0 = free slot, which is BattleUnit_Alloc's test.

fields.name: humanControlled
fields.comment: Copied from realm +0x05. Set means Battle_UpdateAllUnits skips this unit's order handler.

fields.name: figureCount
fields.comment: Figures actually created, counted up in BattleUnit_Create.

fields.name: side
fields.comment: 0 or 4 - not 0/1.

fields.name: firstFigure
fields.comment: Lowest figure index belonging to this unit.

fields.name: lastFigure
fields.comment: Highest; sweeps are for (i = first; i <= last; i++).

fields.name: category
fields.comment: 1 missile, 2 peasants/pikemen, 3 macemen/swordsmen, 4 knights, 5 catapult, 6 tower, 7 ram, 8 oil, 9/10 siege-defender specials. Selects the order handler; recomputed by BattleUnit_Classify.

fields.name: lastAttacker
fields.comment: The unit whose figure last hit this one; field handlers use it as a reaction target.

fields.name: hitMemory
fields.comment: Set to 50 whenever a figure of this unit is hit, decremented per frame pass. Expires long before the 200-frame think interval.

fields.name: inMelee
fields.comment: Set by BattleUnits_RebuildFromFigures when any figure is in melee (state 4); 13 of 17 order handlers refuse to run while set.

fields.name: orderLock
fields.comment: Set to 64 when a unit already in melee is re-ordered by a player click, buying immunity from BattleUnit_JoinMelee. Counted down per rebuild.

fields.name: firing
fields.comment: Set to 120 whenever a figure of this unit shoots or strikes; counts down.

fields.name: withdrawing
fields.comment: Set by Order_StepAwayFromUnit, cleared by every other destination-writing order.

fields.name: timesHit
fields.comment: Wraps. Decremented only once hitMemory reaches zero, so it measures hit frequency; the field missile handler retreats above 10.

fields.name: reTarg
fields.comment: Counts down per frame; at zero resets to 500 and the unit reforms ITS OWN figures. docs/battle-ai.md 5 corrects docs/battle.md: BattleUnit_Reform chooses no enemy anywhere.

fields.name: aimX
fields.comment: With aimY, the aim point recorded when Formation_SendFigure puts a catapult figure into state 12.

fields.name: orders
fields.comment: NOT a player order: a per-unit think counter read as a script program counter (orders < 10, orders % 5 == 0). The label is the game's own debug panel's.

fields.name: think
fields.comment: Incremented every frame the order handler runs; reset past 199, or 99 for two siege-defender handlers, and a decision is made.

fields.name: mapX
fields.comment: Centre of the bounding box of the unit's live figures (BattleUnit_Recentre).

fields.name: targX
fields.comment: Ordered destination.

fields.name: dest2X
fields.comment: A second destination pair, initialised to the unit's own position.

fields.name: halted
fields.comment: Set by Order_ChargeNearest; switches the every-500-frame reform off.

fields.name: withdrawals
fields.comment: Counted by Order_StepAwayFromUnit. FieldFoot allows one, FieldMelee two.

fields.name: orderedTarget
fields.comment: Index of an enemy FIGURE the player told this unit to attack; cleared when that figure dies.

fields.name: targetCell
fields.comment: Destination as a battlefield cell byte offset, (y * 80 + x) * 8.

structs.name: County
structs.comment: A county. 17 records at g_counties, 0x0053F9B0. docs/kingdom.md, docs/screens-county.md.

fields.name: eventFired
fields.comment: Event_RollAll set this county's random event this turn.

fields.name: owner
fields.comment: Realm 1..5; 0 = unowned.

fields.name: industrySharePct
fields.comment: Percentage of the people the allocator gives to industry. [D] FUN_0044F6E7.

fields.name: healthBand
fields.comment: 0..4 = Diseased, Sick, Average, Good, Perfect.

fields.name: happiness
fields.comment: 0..100. L2.eng 85/7 This Season.

fields.name: happinessLast
fields.comment: L2.eng 85/1 Last season.

fields.name: dHapTax
fields.comment: The tax term applied this turn.

fields.name: dHapTaxLocal
fields.comment: The this-county half of the tax effect.

fields.name: dHapHealth
fields.comment: The health term.

fields.name: dHapRation
fields.comment: The ration term.

fields.name: shownTax
fields.comment: Display copy taken when the update ran.

fields.name: taxHapOther
fields.comment: L2.eng 86/4 Other counties; summed into realm +0x28.

fields.name: shownEvents
fields.comment: L2.eng 85/9 From events.

fields.name: happinessAvg
fields.comment: L2.eng 85/8 Average happiness.

fields.name: happinessSum
fields.comment: Running total of happiness over all turns.

fields.name: unrest
fields.comment: 0..4. At 4 the county revolts.

fields.name: popArmy
fields.comment: L2.eng 73 Army. Zeroed by Population_UpdateAll.

fields.name: inflowSources
fields.comment: See crate::population for the documented bug in how this is filled.

fields.name: neighbours
fields.comment: Adjacency ids; MAX_COUNTIES - 2 slots.

fields.name: townTile
fields.comment: Byte offset into g_tiles of the TOP-LEFT tile of the 2x2 county town; the anchor at +0x6C/+0x6D is that block's bottom-right corner. County_FindTownTile fills it, Minimap_Click and Map_Click centre on it. Held all four occupied counties of battle-before.sav - (14,37)/(15,38), (30,49)/(31,50), (36,15)/(37,16), (48,41)/(49,42) - which is what makes County_FindDefendingArmy's asymmetric -2..+1 window read as the town block plus its one-tile ring. Was carried as the single-county global g_county0_townTile until this array was typed.

fields.name: castleX
fields.comment: X of the castle tile, written by County_FindCastleTile. battle-before.sav confirms it from the data side: county 2's pair is (30, 46), that tile carries plane-0 bit 0x80 with content 0x15, and unit slot 4 - the army whose garrisonCounty is 2 - stands exactly there. Distinct from the anchor at +0x6C/+0x6D, which is the county TOWN.

fields.name: castleTile
fields.comment: Byte offset into g_tiles of the castle block, from County_FindCastleTile.

fields.name: dwellingPlots
fields.comment: The four reserved plots, as g_tiles byte offsets. County_FindDwellingPlots fills them by scanning for plane-0 bit 0x10 - maps-layers.md 2.3's exactly-four-per-county - and County_UpdateDwellings raises or clears a dwelling on each. Four slots and no bound check: the array ends exactly on fieldProgress, so a fifth plot would overwrite a field's reclamation progress.

fields.name: fieldProgress
fields.comment: Reclamation progress of each of 20 fields, 0..800. Ends exactly on popBand.

fields.name: taxRate
fields.comment: L2.eng 86/1 Tax rate.

fields.name: taxCollected
fields.comment: What the treasury actually banks.

fields.name: taxShown
fields.comment: L2.eng 86/2 People pay.

fields.name: labour
fields.comment: Nine jobs, L2.eng group 74 strings 1..9.

fields.name: labourShare
fields.comment: Eight percentages, one per job; grain has no share entry.

fields.name: rationAchieved
fields.comment: 0..5, the level Ration_Apply managed to feed.

fields.name: rationSplit
fields.comment: Percentage of the food requirement taken from livestock.

fields.name: grainEaten
fields.comment: Sacks eaten.

fields.name: herdEaten
fields.comment: Head slaughtered.

fields.name: grainAvailable
fields.comment: Cap applied to grainEaten.

fields.name: herdAvailable
fields.comment: Cap applied to herdEaten.

fields.name: shownAle
fields.comment: L2.eng 85/6 From ale.

fields.name: taxSuppressed
fields.comment: When non-zero Tax_CollectAll takes the lower of two figures. Gate untraced.

fields.name: eventId
fields.comment: The event that fired; also its L2.eng index.

fields.name: mercenaryOffer
fields.comment: The band on offer here, 1..12, or 0.

fields.name: garrisonUnit
fields.comment: Unit slot of the army garrisoning this county's castle.

fields.name: castleType
fields.comment: 0 none, 1 palisade, 2 motte and bailey, 3 Norman keep, ...

fields.name: castleBuilding
fields.comment: The type under construction.

fields.name: eventPopulationPct
fields.comment: Percentage swing to population from a random event.

fields.name: purse
fields.comment: An unowned county's own treasury: the tax pass banks its taxCollected here, the AI grants it 100 a season, and Merchant_Trade pays out of it whenever the realm argument is 0. [I] on the name - 0 in every fixture, because no unowned county in any saved position has traded yet. docs/hypotheses.json.

fields.name: fieldsFallow
fields.comment: Read positively by the fertility rule.

fields.name: fieldsCattle
fields.comment: Not read by the fertility rule at all.

fields.name: fieldsGrain
fields.comment: Multiplied by sacks-per-field in Grain_Sow.

fields.name: aleHappinessGiven
fields.comment: Happiness ale has given this county THIS SEASON; caps the bonus at five. Ale_Apply adds to it and Happiness_UpdateAll zeroes it every season - this said 'ever' and it was wrong, docs/decisions.md C53.

fields.name: dryness
fields.comment: The accumulator the weather band is computed from.

fields.name: grain
fields.comment: Sacks in store.

fields.name: crop
fields.comment: The growing crop at its three stages.

fields.name: herd
fields.comment: Head of livestock.

fields.name: herdChangeFromFarming
fields.comment: L2.eng 77 Change due to farming.

fields.name: herdCrowding
fields.comment: 10, 20, 30 or 40 - how crowded the herd is.

fields.name: herdBirthsExpected
fields.comment: L2.eng 77 Calf births expected.

fields.name: herdDeathsExpected
fields.comment: L2.eng 77 Cow deaths expected.

fields.name: industry
fields.comment: Wood, iron, weapons, stone.

fields.name: levySurcharge
fields.comment: Added to the happiness cost of every levy.

structs.name: DiploPair
structs.comment: One realm's view of one other realm, realm +0x84 + other*0x10. docs/diplomacy.md 1.2. The block closes exactly on +0xE4, which is referenced nowhere.

fields.name: standing
fields.comment: How them regards me.

fields.name: allied
fields.comment: Set and cleared in pairs.

fields.name: grudge
fields.comment: Accumulates while allied; past the lord's tolerance the alliance breaks.

fields.name: warningsSent
fields.comment: 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3, the Warning / Warning / Notice of revenge ladder.

fields.name: atWar
fields.comment: Permanently blocks alliance offers once set.

fields.name: complimentsFrom
fields.comment: How many compliments them has sent me. Never reset.

fields.name: bestGift
fields.comment: Largest single gift me has ever had from them.

fields.name: hasMail
fields.comment: A letter from them is waiting in my inbox.

fields.name: helpPriceMultiple
fields.comment: Starts at 1 and rises each time me is paid to help.

structs.name: Industry
structs.comment: One commodity's production record, county +0x290 + c*0x18, c in 0..4 (wood, iron, weapons, stone). docs/kingdom.md 1.3 and 7.4. The 0x18 stride is confirmed by the byte quad at +0x04..+0x07 repeating at county 0x294, 0x2AC, 0x2C4 and 0x2DC.

fields.name: efficiency
fields.comment: Efficiency percentage; ramps, see FUN_0044F248.

fields.name: hasResource
fields.comment: The resource is in the ground here at all.

fields.name: disabledSeasons
fields.comment: Countdown; while non-zero the pass produces nothing.

fields.name: enabled
fields.comment: The industry is switched on.

fields.name: siteTile
fields.comment: Byte offset into g_tiles of this industry's site. County_PlaceResourceSites and County_PlaceBlacksmith store it at load; Industry_UpdateSiteTile writes g_tiles[site].content through it. Four 4-byte accesses, one per commodity.

fields.name: capacity
fields.comment: Workers absorbed at full value. Two bytes, not four - +0x10 is the running total.

fields.name: total
fields.comment: Running total the pass adds this season's output to.

fields.name: totalSnapshot
fields.comment: Last pass's copy of total; output is the difference.

structs.name: LabourSlot
structs.comment: One of the nine jobs a county allocates serfs to. docs/kingdom.md 14.

fields.name: workers
fields.comment: Serfs assigned.

fields.name: wanted
fields.comment: The wanted floor - how many this job asks for.

fields.name: useful
fields.comment: The useful ceiling - above it extra serfs add nothing.

structs.name: Realm
structs.comment: One player, human or AI. 6 records at g_realms, 0x0057BF00. docs/diplomacy.md 1.2, docs/kingdom.md.

fields.name: aiStep
fields.comment: 0..14 program counter through the AI's turn.

fields.name: strength
fields.comment: 3 * ownedCounties + armies, rebuilt each AI turn. Zero means eliminated; every reader but the write only tests it against zero, which is why docs/kingdom.md 2 called it inPlay.

fields.name: isHuman
fields.comment: Set means a person drives this realm; the AI turn machine is skipped.

fields.name: lord
fields.comment: 0 human, 1..5 an AI lord, 6 knocked out. Indexes g_aiPersonality and g_aiGoldGrant - NOT the realm id or the shield.

fields.name: pen
fields.comment: Palette index this realm writes its own text in - g_realmColour[shieldIndex*2], written once at new game and never recomputed. CountyStrip_Draw passes it to Ui_DrawText for all three Sovereign land of ... lines. Shield 1..5 gives 0x0E red, 0xFB yellow, 0x3A near-black, 0x05 magenta, 0x04 blue.

fields.name: penHighlight
fields.comment: The brighter half of the g_realmColour pair - 0x0F, 0x0D, 0x20, 0xFD, 0xF0 for shields 1..5. Written beside pen and read by nothing in the decompiled corpus.

fields.name: shieldIndex
fields.comment: 1..5, the banner colour.

fields.name: meanHappiness
fields.comment: Mean happiness over owned counties. Score input.

fields.name: offerPending
fields.comment: An alliance offer to a human is outstanding.

fields.name: taxHapEmpire
fields.comment: Sum of every owned county's taxHapOther.

fields.name: rank
fields.comment: 1..5 from Score_RankRealms.

fields.name: armyNameCount
fields.comment: One counter per army-name slot; L2.eng groups 94..98. Ends exactly on +0x45.

fields.name: totalMen
fields.comment: Total men over this realm's armies. Score input, weighted /5.

fields.name: shareOfMapPct
fields.comment: PctOf(ownedCounties, g_countyCount).

fields.name: allyCandidate
fields.comment: Who ai_diplomacy has decided to court.

fields.name: ally
fields.comment: One byte, so one ally. 0 for none.

fields.name: pairs
fields.comment: This realm's view of each other realm.

fields.name: musterCounty
fields.comment: The AI's chosen muster county.

fields.name: targetCounty
fields.comment: The county an ally has been asked to march on. NOT warTarget.

fields.name: tauntTimer
fields.comment: Counts to 8 before a taunt is sent.

fields.name: tauntStage
fields.comment: 0 How are you doing?, 1 Helpful advice.

fields.name: warTarget
fields.comment: The realm this one has resolved to attack, 0 for none.

fields.name: offerTimer
fields.comment: Counts up to the lord's offer_interval between alliance offers.

fields.name: crownedOnce
fields.comment: One-shot guard on Just call me king.

fields.name: wages
fields.comment: This season's army bill.

fields.name: tradeSpentA
fields.comment: Crowns spent at the merchant. Merchant_Trade adds the bill to +0x108 then +0x104; nothing else writes either and NOTHING READS EITHER. Game_SetupRealmsAndCounties zeroes all four at new game and no season resets them, so neither is a per-season figure - which is why the names are a and b. docs/decisions.md C54.

fields.name: tradeSpentB
fields.comment: The mirror of +0x104; both take the same number on every purchase.

fields.name: tradeReceivedA
fields.comment: Crowns taken at the merchant. Merchant_Trade adds the proceeds to +0x110 then +0x10C. Unread and never reset, like the spending pair.

fields.name: tradeReceivedB
fields.comment: The mirror of +0x10C.

fields.name: gold
fields.comment: The treasury.

fields.name: weapons
fields.comment: One counter per weapon type. Ends exactly on bankruptStage.

fields.name: bankruptStage
fields.comment: 0..5, the escalation in Wages_PayAll.

fields.name: voiceRotation
fields.comment: 0..3, advanced after every message this realm sends.

structs.name: Tile
structs.comment: One campaign-map tile. 4096 records at g_tiles, 0x00522F90, in a 64 x 64 grid. INDEXED BY BYTE OFFSET, not by record index: tileOffset = (y * 64 + x) * 8, so a step east is +8 and a step south is +0x200. docs/formats/maps-layers.md 5.3.

fields.name: content
fields.comment: What stands on the tile. The enumeration is selected by the flags byte, not global: on an 0x80 site 1/2/3 iron, 4/5/6 stone, 7/8/9 weapons, 10/11/12 wood as idle/working/wrecked (Unit_TrampleTile, Industry_UpdateSiteTile), 0x14 castle plot and 0x15..0x19 a castle (Unit_Step's dispatch); on an 0x10 dwelling plot 0x10..0x13, largest to smallest (Unit_BurnDwelling, FUN_004684c6); on an 0x20 farm tile 0 wild, 1 fallow, 2..14 grain, 15..22 pasture, 25+ being reclaimed (County_RecountFields).

fields.name: flags
fields.comment: The stored plane-0 flags. 0x01 road, 0x02 county boundary, 0x08 rough, 0x10 dwelling plot, 0x20 farm field, 0x40 county town, 0x80 castle or industry site. Unit_TryEnterTile returns one code per bit; decisions.md C25 for the 0x40/0x80 order.

fields.name: bank
fields.comment: Tile-set selector in bits 0x1C (0 base, 4 mtns, 8 roads, 0xC town, 0x10 castle), plus run-time bits the file never carries: 0x20 is the fog-of-war seen bit, tested only when g_optExploration is 1.

fields.name: frame
fields.comment: Frame index within the bank's PL8.

fields.name: part
fields.comment: Plane 3 verbatim: the tile's index inside a multi-tile object, dx + width*dy. Read as & 0xF; FUN_00467770 walks back to the anchor with (part % w) * -8 + (part / w) * -0x200.

fields.name: unit
fields.comment: Slot in g_units of the unit standing here, 0 for none. Unit_TryEnterTile reads it first of all, and County_FindDefendingArmy scans this plane.

fields.name: savedFrame
fields.comment: The terrain frame stashed before a building was stamped on the tile, and copied back into frame when it is removed. Written by the dwelling-plot scan, read by FUN_004684c6's else branch.

fields.name: county
fields.comment: Plane 5 verbatim: county id, 0 for no county.

structs.name: Unit
structs.comment: An army, mob, merchant or transport - told apart by the type byte at +0x08. 151 records at g_units, 0x0052F0B0; slot 0 is never a unit. docs/armies.md 1.

fields.name: owner
fields.comment: Realm 1..5. 0 means the slot is free.

fields.name: ownerIsHuman
fields.comment: A copy of realm +0x05 taken at creation, not a live read.

fields.name: shield
fields.comment: A copy of realm +0x0A, the banner.

fields.name: playerDriven
fields.comment: 1 for armies made by Army_Create; suppresses the automatic order.

fields.name: kind
fields.comment: Army / mob / merchant / transport. g_unitTickTable has one handler each.

fields.name: facing
fields.comment: 0..7, the direction of the last step.

fields.name: x
fields.comment: Tile 0..63.

fields.name: tileOffset
fields.comment: [V] Byte offset into g_tiles (0x00522F90, 4096 x 8): (y * 64 + x) * 8. Found by this retyping - FUN_00466d84 steps it by 8 per column and 0x200 per row alongside x and y, Unit_TryEnterTile is called with it plus the eight neighbour deltas, the unit-index plane at g_tiles+5 is written at [tileOffset], and one site assigns (g_foundTileY * 0x40 + g_foundTileX) * 8. This retyping reached it independently; docs/armies.md §1.1 has carried the same field, with the same formula and the same [V], since the campaign-map layer was written, so the four checks above are a re-derivation of an existing claim rather than a new one.

fields.name: county
fields.comment: The county the unit is standing in; Army_Tick keeps it current.

fields.name: homeCounty
fields.comment: Where it was raised. L2.eng 31/9 An army from.

fields.name: destX
fields.comment: End of the ordered path.

fields.name: path
fields.comment: 150 (x, y) pairs, in travel order. 0x1D + 150*2 = 0x149, the next referenced offset.

fields.name: moving
fields.comment: 0 idle, 2 moving.

fields.name: onRoad
fields.comment: The tile just entered was a road.

fields.name: nameIndex
fields.comment: Index into L2.eng group 93 + owner, 0..23.

fields.name: needsDestination
fields.comment: Idle, no orders.

fields.name: destCounty
fields.comment: The county the current order leads to.

fields.name: movesUsed
fields.comment: Moves spent this season.

fields.name: moveAllowance
fields.comment: 15 for an army, 10 for the other three; rewritten every tick.

fields.name: starvation
fields.comment: 0..5, drawn as L2.eng 31/(27 + value).

fields.name: wages
fields.comment: This unit's share of its realm's wage bill. L2.eng 31/8.

fields.name: yearFormed
fields.comment: L2.eng 31/20 Formed. Two bytes - a year does not fit in one.

fields.name: morale
fields.comment: L2.eng 31/21 Morale. Copied from the county's happiness.

fields.name: menTotal
fields.comment: The total. Wages, sprite class, starvation and the 1500 cap all read it.

fields.name: troops
fields.comment: The campaign writes types 0..6; Battle_RaiseSide walks all eleven and Army_PrepareForBattle fills 7..10 from the siege records at +0x182.

fields.name: mercTroop
fields.comment: 0..6, the mercenary band's troop type.

fields.name: mercMen
fields.comment: A byte, and nothing clamps it.

fields.name: mercBand
fields.comment: Band id 1..12.

fields.name: garrisonCounty
fields.comment: Non-zero: inside that county's castle.

fields.name: besiegingCounty
fields.comment: Non-zero: camped outside that county's castle.

fields.name: besiegedBy
fields.comment: On a garrison, the slot of its besieger.
